dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いします。時間になったら始めたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for being here. We’ll get started once it’s time.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。どうぞ宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: それでは始めたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Alright, let's begin.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 相談内容、年齢、性別を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Could you please tell me what you'd like to discuss, as well as your age and gender?

dialogue.content: パートで事務の仕事をしているのですが、先日、社員の打診をされました。その件で少し迷っています
dialogue.English: I work a part-time office job, and the other day I was offered a full-time position. I'm a bit torn about it.

dialogue.content: 42歳女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 42-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: 社員への昇格についての悩みですね。どういう点が気になっているのですか？
dialogue.English: So you're feeling conflicted about the promotion to a full-time employee. What aspects are concerning you?

dialogue.content: はい。過去に、同じように昇格したパートの人は、急に仕事の負荷が増えてみんな退職してしまいました
dialogue.English: Yes. In the past, other part-timers who were promoted like this all ended up quitting because their workload suddenly increased dramatically.

dialogue.content: 私もそうなるのではと不安です
dialogue.English: I'm anxious that the same thing might happen to me.

dialogue.content: なるほど。今までの傾向を考えると、自分もそうなるのではと不安になりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. Considering the past trend, it's understandable that you would feel anxious that the same thing might happen to you.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 今までの昇格した方はどれくらい仕事量が増えたのですか？
dialogue.English: For those who were promoted, how much did their workload increase?

dialogue.content: パートは基本的にサポート的な仕事なので、時間が来たら帰れます。でも社員になると担当のクライアントを持たされるので、その分は自分で責任を持たなければいけません
dialogue.English: As a part-timer, my job is mostly support-related, so I can leave when my time is up. But as a full-time employee, I would be assigned my own clients, which means I'd have to take personal responsibility for them.

dialogue.content: だから残業もずいぶんしていました
dialogue.English: That's why they ended up doing a lot of overtime.

dialogue.content: 残業があり、責任ものしかかるとなる事を考えるのは心苦しいですよね。
dialogue.English: It must be distressing to think about the overtime and the added responsibility that would fall on you.

dialogue.content: 相談者さまは業務の変化についてどう考えてますか？
dialogue.English: What are your thoughts on the changes in job duties?

dialogue.content: もし私が社員になったら、家族の協力がないと家のことが回せなくなると思います
dialogue.English: If I became a full-time employee, I don’t think I could manage things at home without my family’s cooperation.

dialogue.content: そうですね。仕事を重視したら家族、家庭に影響が出たりしますよね。
dialogue.English: That's true. Focusing more on work can certainly affect your family and home life.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 実は
dialogue.English: Actually...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 私は今、パートですが、いくつか担当のクライアントを持っています
dialogue.English: Even though I'm a part-timer, I already have a few clients I'm responsible for.

dialogue.content: なので、社員と仕事内容はあまり変わりません
dialogue.English: So my job duties aren't that different from a full-time employee's.

dialogue.content: パートの立場で社員の仕事を一部しているんですね。
dialogue.English: So you're already doing some of the work of a full-time employee as a part-timer.

dialogue.content: ただ、責任の度合いが違うくらい
dialogue.English: It's just that the level of responsibility is different.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: だからそのまま社員にならないかと打診されたんだと思います
dialogue.English: That's probably why they offered me the full-time position as is.

dialogue.content: なるほど。極端に業務内容が変わる訳ではないのですね。では家族の事を除いて、仕事内容が変化することには何か気になる点、心配事などありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. So your duties wouldn't change drastically. Setting aside your family concerns for a moment, is there anything else about the change in your job that worries you?

dialogue.content: お給料のことも気になります
dialogue.English: I'm also concerned about the salary.

dialogue.content: 今は時給ですが、社員になると賞与も出る
dialogue.English: Right now I'm paid hourly, but as a full-time employee, I would get bonuses.

dialogue.content: お金は重要ですよね。賞与も魅力的ですよね。
dialogue.English: Money is important, of course. And bonuses are certainly appealing.

dialogue.content: はい。同じ業務をやっているならもらえるならそっちの方がとおもいますが、
dialogue.English: Yes. I feel that if I'm doing the same work, I should be getting those benefits, but...

dialogue.content: 業務量と責任が重すぎる気がして踏み切れません
dialogue.English: I feel the workload and responsibility would be too heavy, so I can’t take the plunge.

dialogue.content: 確かにそうですね。社員の仕事をしていて、社員の待遇が受けれないのは気持ちよくないですよね。
dialogue.English: That's certainly true. It must not feel good to be doing the work of a full-time employee without receiving the same compensation.

dialogue.content: ではいくつか相談者さまの考えを聞いてみたいのですが、
dialogue.English: I’d like to ask a few questions to better understand your thoughts.

dialogue.content: はい。ちょっと納得いかないなと思います。でも、きっと負荷が増えると考えると迷います
dialogue.English: Yes. I feel it's a bit unfair. But when I think about how the workload will likely increase, I hesitate.

dialogue.content: すいません。行き違いになりましたね。
dialogue.English: My apologies. It seems we got our wires crossed.

dialogue.content: すみません。大丈夫です
dialogue.English: No worries. It’s okay.

dialogue.content: 業務量と責任が増えて、収入が増えたら家族や家庭の事をその分犠牲にできそうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If your workload, responsibilities, and income were to increase, would you be able to sacrifice your family and home life to that extent?

dialogue.content: そうですね。。。そこまでして必死になりたい仕事かなとも考えてしまいます
dialogue.English: Let’s see… It makes me wonder whether it’s a job I want to throw myself into that intensely.

dialogue.content: なるほど。今のパートの仕事に対する意欲はそこまで、、、というお気持ちなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you're feeling that your motivation for your current part-time job isn't quite at that level.

dialogue.content: そうですね…無茶振りが多い職場なので、いろいろ納得いかない事もあります
dialogue.English: That’s right… It’s a workplace with a lot of unreasonable demands, so there are many things I don’t agree with.

dialogue.content: では抽象的かもしれませんが、そこまで必死にならなくてもという事柄（仕事でもそれ以外の事でも）に長時間労力をかけれるか、どう思われますか？
dialogue.English: This might be a bit abstract, but how do you feel about dedicating long hours to something (whether it's work or something else) that you don't feel that passionate about?

dialogue.content: 最初は頑張れるかもしれませんが、だんだん嫌になってくるのではと思います
dialogue.English: I might be able to push through it at first, but I think I would gradually start to resent it.

dialogue.content: そうですね。自分自身が納得のいかない事をやらされるのは嫌ですよね。場合によっては辛くなってきますよね。
dialogue.English: I agree. It's unpleasant to be forced to do something you don't find acceptable. In some cases, it can become painful.

dialogue.content: はい。そう思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so too.

dialogue.content: それでは、今回の話の要点をまとめてみますね。少し待ってもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Okay, let me summarize the main points of our conversation. Could you give me a moment?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Sure.

dialogue.content: まず環境について。既に業務内容は納得のいかない状態になっている。収入は上がるが、業務と責任が増える。無茶ぶりが多い職場。
dialogue.English: First, regarding the environment. Your current duties are already in a state you find unsatisfactory. Your income would increase, but so would your workload and responsibilities. And it's a workplace with many unreasonable demands.

dialogue.content: 相談者さまについて仕事内容と給料にズレを感じている。仕事そのものにそれほど魅力を感じていない。家族や家庭を犠牲にできない。
dialogue.English: And about you: you feel there's a disconnect between your job duties and your pay. You don't find the work itself that appealing. And you can't sacrifice your family and home life.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？まとめについて、間違っているところはないですか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound? Is there anything incorrect in that summary?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: That's accurate.

dialogue.content: では、環境についてですが仮に相談者さまがこういう職場をはたから見たら、どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: Then, regarding the environment, if you were to look at a workplace like this from the outside, what would you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね…組織がなってないと思います。
dialogue.English: Let me see… I’d think the organization isn’t functioning properly.

dialogue.content: なるほど。確かに組織として考えたら、大丈夫？って思う状態ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Indeed, from an organizational standpoint, it’s the kind of situation that makes you wonder, "Is this okay?"

dialogue.content: そうなんです。これからルールが整備されて行くんだと思いますが、今はまだ中途半端なことが多いと思います
dialogue.English: Exactly. I think the rules will be put in place going forward, but right now a lot of things are still half-baked.

dialogue.content: では整備されていきそうだという具体的な動きはありましたか？
dialogue.English: Have there been any concrete steps to suggest that things are being put in order?

dialogue.content: チームの編成など体制を整える動きはありますが、どれもピンと来ない感じかも知れません
dialogue.English: There are moves to improve the structure, like reorganizing teams, but none of it really feels convincing.

dialogue.content: なるほど。変わるかもしれないし、あんまり変化しないかもといった状態なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So it's a situation where things might change, but they might not change much either.

dialogue.content: ちょっと言葉を変えて聞いてみたのですが、
dialogue.English: Let me try asking in a slightly different way...

dialogue.content: そうですね。あまり期待できないかな。
dialogue.English: Right. I'm not very hopeful.

dialogue.content: 組織としてなっていない職場で仕事に対してやる気はそんなに、、、という状態でたくさんの仕事と責任がのしかかったら、健やかに働けますか？
dialogue.English: In a poorly organized workplace where you don't feel very motivated, if you were burdened with a lot of work and responsibility, do you think you could work in a healthy way?

dialogue.content: きっと納得いかないことが起こるのではと思います。やりがいを持って…と言うにはほど遠いかな
dialogue.English: I’m sure things I can’t agree with would happen. It would be far from what I’d call meaningful or fulfilling.

dialogue.content: そうですね。不安や疑問といったマイナスの考えが浮かんできますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Negative thoughts like anxiety and doubt come to mind, don't they?

dialogue.content: はい。そうですね。気持ちはワクワクしないですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. I don't feel excited about it at all.

dialogue.content: ええ、ワクワクしないですよね。ここまでで当初の昇格に対する疑問の答えが浮かんできたのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, you don't feel excited. Through our conversation so far, perhaps an answer to your initial question about the promotion has started to emerge?

dialogue.content: そうですね。お給料のことがあって、社員も考えましたが、やはり踏み込むべき領域ではない気がします。今の業務量も不満はありますが、責任という事を考えたら仕方ないのかな
dialogue.English: You're right. I considered the full-time position because of the salary, but I feel it's not something I should step into. I'm not happy with my current workload either, but I guess it's unavoidable considering the level of responsibility.

dialogue.content: ええ、それに大切な家庭もありますし、相談者さまが仕事が原因でつぶれてしまっては元も子もないですもんね。
dialogue.English: Yes, and you have your important family life. It would defeat the purpose if you were to burn out because of the job.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: お時間も来ましたが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: We’re about out of time—how are you feeling?

dialogue.content: はい、頭の中が整理されてよかったです
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm glad I was able to sort out my thoughts.

dialogue.content: 不明点など大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any remaining questions?

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です
dialogue.English: No, I’m fine.

dialogue.content: では、現在の職場で社員の昇格について悩んでいるという相談でした。結果職場や昇格後の業務内容に疑問があるため、遠慮するという考えに至りました。これで良かったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Okay, so you came to me because you were concerned about a promotion to a full-time position at your current job. As a result, you've come to the conclusion that you will decline the offer due to your doubts about the workplace and the post-promotion responsibilities. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: はい。今すぐ社員になることはやめておきます
dialogue.English: Yes. I'll hold off on becoming a full-time employee right now.

dialogue.content: わかりました。それではこれで相談を終了したいと思います。お疲れさまでした。
dialogue.English: Understood. Well then, I'd like to conclude our session here. Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: たくさん聴いていただきありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening so attentively.

dialogue.content: （ロールプレイお疲れ様でした。どうもありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play. I appreciate it very much.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.English: (That was great. Thank you very much!)

dialogue.content: （それでは失礼します。）
dialogue.English: (Well then, goodbye.)

dialogue.content: （失礼します）
dialogue.English: (Goodbye.)
